entries.def:
μίσθωμα, -τος, τό
(μισθόω), [in LXX: Deu.23.18 (19), Mic.1.7, Ezk.16.31, 34; 16.41 (אֶתְנַן), Ezk.16.33, (נֵדֶה, נָדָן), Ezk.16.32, Pro.19.13 * ;] 
__1. price, hire (cl, and LXX). 
__2. In sense not found elsewhere, a hired dwelling: Act.28.30.†
(AS)

μισθωτός, -ή, όν 
(μισθόω), [in LXX for שָׂכִיר, Exo.12.45, al. ;] 
hired; as subst., ὁ μ., a hired servant, hireling: Mrk.1.20, Jhn.10.12-13.† 
(AS)

Μιτυλήνη, -ης, ἡ
(late form - Strab., Plut. - of cl. Μυτιλ-), 
Mytilene, Mitylene, chief city of Lesbos: Act.20.14.†
(AS)

Μιχαήλ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִיכָאֵל, who like God?), 
Michael, the Archangel (cf. Dan.12.1) : Jude.9, Rev.12.7.†
(AS)

μνᾶ, -ᾶς, ἡ
(a Semitic word; cf. Heb. מָנֶה, Aram. מְנֵא, a weight and a sum of money = 100 shekels, cf. 1Ki.10.17), 
a mina (Let.), mna, in Attic a weight and sum of money = 100 δραχμαί (which see) : Luk.19.13, 16; 19.18, 20; 19.24-25.†
(AS)

μνάομαι, see: μιμινήσκω.
μιμνήσκω
(Bl., -ῄ-, § 3, 3), [in LXX chiefly for זָכַר ;] 
to remind: mid, and pass.; 
__(a) reflexive, to remind oneself of, hence, to remember: with genitive of thing(s), Mat.26.75, Luk.1.54, 72; 24.8, Act.11.16, 2Pe.3.2, Jude.17; with neg., of sins, = to forgive, Heb.8.12; 10.17" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s), Luk.23.42 before ὅτι, Mat.5.23; 27.63, Luk.16.25, Jhn.2.17, 22; 12.16; ὡς,…

μνεία, -ας, ἡ
(μιμνήσκω), [in LXX for זָכַר, its parts and deriva­tives ;] 
remembrance, mention (= μνήμη) : Php.1.3 μ. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive of person(s), Rom.1.9, Eph.1.16, 1Th.1.2, Phm 4 (cf. Psa.111.4); μ. ἔχειν, with genitive of person(s), 1Th.3.6, 2Ti.1.3 (on the seel. in Rom.12.13, see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163).†
(AS)

μνῆμα, -τος, τό
(μνάομαι), [in LXX for קֶבֶר, קְבוּרָה ;] 
__1. a memorial. 
__2. a sepulchral monument, a sepulchre, tomb: Mrk.5.3, 5; 15.46; 16.2 (WH, μνημεῖον), Luk.8.27; 23.53; 24.1, Act.2.29; 7.16, Rev.11.9.†
SYN.: μνημεῖον (AS)

μνημεῖον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX for קֶבֶר, קְבוּרָה ;] 
__1. a memorial, record (cl., cf. Wis.10.7). 
__2. (a) (cl.) a monument: Luk.11.47 
__(b) a sepulchre, tomb (Gen.23.6, 9, Isa.22.16, al.): Mat.23.29, Mrk.5.2, Luk.11.44, Jhn.5.28, and frequently in Gospels, Act.13.29 
SYN.: μνῆμα (AS)
